items.title: Ukraine seeks additional €8 billion in military funding and 40 F-16 fighters
items.summary: During a video address to a meeting of Ukraine's Western military supporters in Brussels, President Volodymyr Zelensky reportedly requested another €8 billion this year to address military budget needs, alongside funding for drone production and 40 additional F-16 fighter jets. He also sought Mirage aircraft and air-defence interceptors from European stockpiles. The requests have not been confirmed as new aid commitments.
